usermeta.idiom: Map: choropleth with a lookup join (required map #3)
todo: Run  python scripts/prep_threatened.py data/12102026-044553-report.csv  to build data/threatened_marine_by_state.csv. Its docstring says exactly which rows are counted.
The lookup joins on properties.STATE_NAME in data/aus_states.geojson; the names match the 'state' column in the CSV.
'Marine' here means recorded in the Commonwealth Marine Area. The ACT still shows 3 because the report marks three of those taxa as present there; decide whether to explain that or grey the ACT out.
Counts overlap between states: a taxon can appear in several. Say so in the caption. The range is narrow (25 to 57 outside the ACT), so the map shows small differences.
Consider adding offshore territories if your states file includes them.

title.text: Threatened marine species by state and territory
subtitle: EPBC-listed threatened species found in Commonwealth waters, counted
in each jurisdiction where they are present. A species can count in more than one.
